FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 143
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/09/2026
Senate Bill 143 as introduced would remove the expiration date of August 31, 2028 from the
current supplemental privilege assessment, the secondary supplemental privilege assessment,
and the monthly surcharge on nursing home beds. In fiscal year 2025, after deducting the costs
of collection, these nursing home bed taxes generated approximately $117 million for the
Alabama Medicaid Agency. The Alabama Medicaid Agency estimates $117 million will be
collected in fiscal year 2026 from these assessments.
